opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as a network-based income and asset opportunity, expressly tying earnings to building a team and describing a separate capital-growth or asset opportunity. Members are offered exclusive worldwide rights to mine the coins, while a network of miners is said to create the market and mine them. The presentation further promises an asset that can yield dividends for years and says participants can keep most of the profits. Viewers are encouraged to join at the beginning because the opportunity is asserted to grow. Taken together, these are company-promotional claims about income, asset growth, mining rights, dividends, and profit participation, delivered as an invitation to get involved rather than detached reporting.
